_comment: Sokoban is turn-based — every action fires on press-edge (one move per keypress, not every frame held). Universal lib registers WASD/Arrow with edge=hold by default; we re-declare each movement action with edge=press AFTER the $include to override the edge classification (last-writer-wins per ADR 0043). The lib's key bindings (W/Up etc.) carry through. R for restart.
